title: Staining with P-RANbodies
author: Masahito Yamagata
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pqadmse

steps.title: Fix cultured cells
steps.instruction: Fix cultured cells with 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde/PBS at 4 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Permeabilize and treat with H2O2
steps.instruction: Treat cells with 0.1% (w/v) Triton X-100/PBS supplemented with 0.3% (w/v) H2O2 at 4 °C for 15 min.

substeps.instruction: If cells or tissues show endogenous peroxidase activity, incubate with 0.3% H2O2 for a longer duration (e.g., a couple of hours to overnight).
Alternatively, perform this step with 0.3% H2O2 in methanol at -20 °C overnight, depending on the RANbody-antigen reaction.

steps.title: Rinse cells
steps.instruction: Rinse cells with PBS (e.g., 3 min x 3 times).

steps.title: Block cells
steps.instruction: Block cells with 5% (w/v) skim milk in PBS at room temperature for 30 min.

substeps.instruction: BSA or other blocking agents may be used instead of skim milk.
Sodium azide (NaN3, 0.02% w/v) can be included in the blocker.
Rinse extensively if sodium azide was used in the blocking step.

steps.title: Stain with tyramide dye
steps.instruction: Stain cells using a tyramide dye (e.g., TSA Plus kit from Perkin-Elmer, such as Cyanine 3 or Fluorescein Evaluation Kits).

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 5 min to 30 min (can be extended up to 3-4 hours).
Ensure cells do not dry out.

steps.title: Rinse stained cells
steps.instruction: Rinse stained cells with PBS overnight (incubate without changing PBS) to remove background.

substeps.instruction: This long rinse may be omitted if the signal is intense or if a second immunostaining is necessary (in which case, start the second immunostaining from this step).

steps.title: Mount cells
steps.instruction: Mount cells in Fluoro-Gel (Electron Microscopy Sciences) or a similar mounting reagent.
